snippet.title: Beware of the Cartographer! Announcement Trailer 🗺️
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3905500/Beware_of_the_Cartographer/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=teaser&utm_campaign=description

Map a mysterious land during the Age of Enlightenment. Draw the border between two warring kingdoms. Meet the locals. Juggle their demands with the requirements of your mission. Ethical dilemmas, secret plots, strange phenomena… will you be able to bring peace back to the land? 

A game by Quentin Vijoux and Tohu Bohu Games.

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/8BV7NVbZ6M
Subscribe to our newsletter: https://shorturl.at/3LWbw
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tohubohugames/

Trailer made by:
Paul Lejeune: animations
Luc Armanet: animations
Matthieu Corno: editing
Joachim Neuville: music and SFX
Julie “Yllogique” Robert: consulting

Still reading? You must be a journalist. Check out our press kit: https://presskit.tohubohu.games/beware-of-the-cartographer
